scalars.scalar_value: A bachelor’s degree in English or Literature preferred, or any combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.
Demonstrated capacity for executing substantial editing and significant writing experience.
Vice President and Chief Civil Rights Officer

The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Overtime, holiday, weekend, and evening work hours may be required. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College.

items.item_text: A bachelor’s degree in English or Literature preferred, or any combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.
Demonstrated capacity for executing substantial editing and significant writing experience.
Facilitate dialogue around communication across difference and increase community engagement around identity development education and constructive dialogue.
Serve as content contributor and editor of the College’s Civil Rights Policy.
Develop and maintain the design and function for the CARE Center physical space.
Create design content for publications and communications.
Serve as a member of the leadership team for the CARE Center.
Provide guidance, leadership, and mentorship as well as develop programming to support student development.
Assist with case management and records keeping regarding highly confidential matters.
Provide strategic support to Accessibility Services with program development and student engagement.
Administer information on the accommodation process and assist with the implementation of accommodations.
Provide organizational support for Title IX and other Civil Rights programming and policy matters.
Demonstrated commitment to constructive dialogue and evidenced capacity for communicating across difference.
Familiarity with Maxient and Workday is desired.
Exceptional understanding of confidentiality and the capacity to exercise discretion, good judgment, courtesy and tact while working with people from a wide variety of backgrounds.
Deep understanding and appreciation for analytical thinking and problem solving.
Ability to execute projects and meet deadlines independently.

pay.source_text: $30.00 - $33.65 per hour. Claremont McKenna College offers employee benefits that include health, dental, and vision plans;
